title: Irandaam Ulagam
desc: Madhu, traumatised by the sudden deaths of his father and girlfriend, tries to commit suicide, but is rescued by a stranger who looks exactly like him and transported to a distant planet.

title: Mundasupatti
desc: Gopi, a professional photographer, goes to a remote village along with his friend. However, the villagers are suspicious about their cameras.

title: Nagashaurya's Aswathama
desc: A man returns to India for his sister's engagement ceremony but discovers that something terrible has happened to her. On his quest for the truth, he uncovers a series of crimes against women.

title: Yamakaathaghi
desc: After the demise of a young woman, her spirit remains inside her funeral home and refuses to leave. Soon, her death leads to a disturbing supernatural investigation.

title: Thittam Irandu
desc: While her marriage preparations are underway, Inspector Athira is busy investigating the death of her friend Deepa. Later, her life turns upside down when the whole mystery unfolds before her eyes.

title: Vettai
desc: An inspector covertly collaborates with his brother to discipline offenders, but when a gangster uncovers their secret, the officer resolves to train under his sibling to confront the criminal.

title: Taanakkaran
desc: Arivu and his trainee friends face the wrath of a ruthless trainer, Eshwaramurthy, who later plots schemes to demotivate and punish the entire batch.

title: Ayyanar
desc: Prabha, an idler, is always compared to his younger brother due to his careless attitude. However, when his brother gets killed, he joins a criminal gang to find the people who murdered him.

title: M.C.A - Middle Class Ambala
desc: Nani, a middle-class boy with an eidetic memory, helps save his sister-in-law from a goon. Meanwhile, he also tries to convince his girlfriend's father to marry her off to him.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Monster
desc: Anjanam, who respects all life forms, faces trouble after a rat creates havoc in his house. While he tries to get rid of the rodent, a criminal breaks into his home to find his missing diamonds.

title: Saravanan Irukka Bayamaen
desc: Saravanan, a lackadaisical young man, stumbles into power as the local political head. Subsequently, armed with clueless confidence, he uses his new role to impress the girl of his dreams.

title: Kazhugu 2
desc: Two thieves get mistaken for huntsmen upon reaching a new place. So, they use the misunderstanding as an opportunity to take advantage and hide from the law.

title: Vacha Kuri Thappaathu
desc: Karthik, a businessman, gets married to a rich woman, to increase his wealth. However, things change, when he falls in love with an environmental activist, who files a suit against his company.

title: Thambi
desc: Parvathy is hesitant to accept her brother, Saravanan, who returns home after 15 years. Soon, she discovers that not everything is as it seems and uncovers a well-planned conspiracy.

title: Ungalukkaga Oruvan
desc: A wealthy entrepreneur returns home to reconcile with a former classmate. Upon discovering his companion's dire predicament, he intervenes and becomes a heroic saviour for the entire community.

title: Killer
desc: In Vizag and Aruku, a series of murders unfold. Meanwhile, a couple unknowingly visits Aruku during their vacation, only for the woman to mysteriously disappear.
